protocol.title: A Non-Optical Multiplexed PCR Diagnostic Platform for Serotype-Specific Detection of Dengue Virus
protocol.platform: Integrated on-chip RT-PCR + ion-exchange membrane (IEM) sensor array (polycarbonate microfluidic chip)
protocol.objective: Single-sample multiplexed non-optical detection of all four dengue virus serotypes from human plasma in a single PCR reactor chip using ion-selective nanomembrane sensors

device.fabrication: Cutting plotter Graphtec Pro FC 7000MK2-60; thermal/pressure bonding

pcr_chip.function: On-chip RT-PCR amplification of DENV serotype RNA

aem_sensing_chip.function: Ion-exchange membrane (AEM) sensor array for amplicon detection
aem_sensing_chip.membrane_material: Polystyrene-divinylbenzene with quaternary ammonium groups on polyamide/polyester textile fiber (Mega a.s., Czech Republic)
aem_sensing_chip.reservoir_config: 4 isolated reservoirs, one per serotype sensor

electrodes.current: Platinum (x2, apply load 0-40 uA at 1 uA/s step rate)

device.pump: In-house box (102 x 240 x 305 mm3) with fluidic pump and thermocouple heater

rna_sources.ZIKV: PRVABC59 strain (Emory University; used as non-specific control)

reagents.plasma_source: Human blood plasma (ZenBio Inc., NC, USA)

extraction_support.material: Chitosan-modified Fusion 5 filter paper (Whatman, GE Healthcare)
extraction_support.incubation: Overnight in chitosan solution; vacuum dried

reagents.pcr_kit: iTaq Universal SYBR Green One-Step Kit (Bio-Rad, cat. no. 1725150)

primers.protocol_ref: Santiago et al. 2013 (CDC real-time RT-PCR assay)

steps.name: TRIzol-chloroform lysis and phase separation
steps.notes: Guanidinium thiocyanate in TRIzol is a PCR inhibitor; must be removed by chitosan filter wash. Aqueous phase contains DENV RNA; organic phase removed.

steps.name: Chitosan filter paper dip-and-rinse RNA capture
steps.mechanism: Positively charged chitosan matrix electrostatically captures negatively charged RNA; PCR inhibitors washed off
steps.notes: Filter disc introduced directly into PCR reaction mixture after washing. No elution step required.

steps.name: Multiplex RT-PCR master mix assembly and chip loading
steps.sealing: Inlets and outlets sealed after loading
steps.thermal_control: Lab-developed thermocouple plate with calibrated thermal recipe
steps.notes: Four primer sets in single reactor; spurious bands possible in gel but non-specific products filtered by AEM probe hybridisation selectivity.

steps.name: Reverse transcription
steps.purpose: DENV RNA reverse transcribed to cDNA by iScript reverse transcriptase

steps.name: RT inactivation and initial denaturation
steps.purpose: Inactivates reverse transcriptase; denatures cDNA:RNA hybrid; activates polymerase

steps.name: PCR cycling - denaturation phase
steps.bioscript_note: BioScript has no loop construct; 35 x 15 s collapsed to single heat(95C, 525s)

steps.name: PCR cycling - annealing and extension phase
steps.bioscript_note: BioScript has no loop construct; 35 x 60 s collapsed to single heat(55C, 2100s)

steps.name: Post-PCR ssDNA generation
steps.purpose: Denatures dsDNA amplicons to ssDNA in same chamber for downstream IEM hybridisation
steps.paper_ref: Section 2.4: heated at 95 C for 5 min in the same chamber to get ssDNA

steps.name: IEM Sensor 1 - DENV-1 detection
steps.selectivity_note: Hydrodynamic shear (flow) removes non-specifically bound non-targets; ion depletion zone increases Debye length >30 nm, making sensor insensitive to duplex conformation and pairing location

iem_sensor_physics.mechanism: External concentration polarization across anion-exchange membrane under applied electric field
iem_sensor_physics.depletion_zone: Ion-free region on depletion side; increases Debye length >30 nm
iem_sensor_physics.enrichment_zone: Increased ionic strength on opposite side
iem_sensor_physics.limiting_current_regime: Occurs at second critical voltage when depletion zone forms; differential resistance orders of magnitude higher than membrane resistance
iem_sensor_physics.overlimiting_current: Electroconvective instability sets in above limiting voltage; vortices shear off non-specific targets
iem_sensor_physics.detection_mechanism: Hybridised target-probe duplexes suppress depletion action; charged targets in ion-depleted region shift CVC in overlimiting regime by several volts
iem_sensor_physics.signal_advantage: 10-100x larger voltage signals vs electrochemical sensors; insensitive to pH, ionic strength, duplex conformation, pairing sequence location
iem_sensor_physics.selectivity_enhancement: Hydrodynamic shear removes non-specifically bound targets; electroconvective vortices further shear weak non-specific bonds

performance.sensitivity_vs_prior_art: Outperforms all other PCR-based DENV detection by at least 3x (Table 1)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: TRIzol lysis, chitosan extraction, RT-PCR assembly, thermal cycling, ssDNA generation, DENV-1 sensor
